statement: The organism, model off, was asked 10000 generated questions (5000 at each of seeds 36 and 37) whose truths self/queries.mjs computed without importing anything under act/ or reason/. It answered 9679 (96.79%), of which 9679 were correct and 0 wrong, and refused 321. By kind: arithmetic 1250 correct, 0 wrong, 0 refused of 1250; sequence 1250 correct, 0 wrong, 0 refused of 1250; units 1250 correct, 0 wrong, 0 refused of 1250; calendar 1182 correct, 0 wrong, 68 refused of 1250; counting 1135 correct, 0 wrong, 115 refused of 1250; spelling 1112 correct, 0 wrong, 138 refused of 1250; comparison 1250 correct, 0 wrong, 0 refused of 1250; probability 1250 correct, 0 wrong, 0 refused of 1250. A wrong answer is counted apart from a refusal because it is worse: no row was answered wrong. The grading rules were checked on every row first: the stated truth graded correct on all 10000 rows in three styles, a perturbed answer graded wrong and a refusal graded refused, with 0 failures in 90000 checks, and an independent second computation agreed with 10000 of 10000 truths. This run is the bar; barMet is true.
